name: voltaic-sphere-graveyard-ability-makes-the-next-arcane-spell-cost-one-less
notes: Voltaic Sphere graveyard ability: Class Bonus, banish from the graveyard: the next arcane Spell costs 1 less. Pre-fix not implemented.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Banish CARDNAME from your graveyard: The next arcane element Spell card you activate this turn costs 1 less to activate.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The engine had no route from a graveyard click to the generated ability bodies (only hand-coded per-card blocks), so this ability could not be used / was never paid. GAFieldAbilityCostTable() entries flagged 'graveyard' now pay the (N) and banish the card, and ActionMap() routes the click through ActivateAbility. The discount is a global effect applied (and consumed when paid) in ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers via GAVoltaicSphereDiscount().
